name: LUCY-ui
tagline: Lucy's face: a browser client for the LUCY hub with an expressive face, streamed text and approval cards.
description: The LUCY hub's web client. An animated face whose mood is a pure function of the conversation's event stream, a transcript that streams Lucy's words in and never says anything twice, and approval cards answered in place, including a standing yes limited to the values the card names. It reads the hub's native resumable event stream and needs no change to the hub. A headed mode lets a coding agent drive a conversation from a terminal while a person watches it, and answers its approval cards, in the browser.
highlights: A face whose twelve moods are derived from the hub's event stream, never set by hand
Resumable streaming: reconnects from the last event handled, so nothing is shown twice
Approval cards with once, conversation, profile and always, limited to chosen values
Headed mode: a terminal drives Lucy, the browser follows and answers the card
Every module at 100% coverage; end-to-end tests in three engines against a fake hub
